 TEN (NCT) affirms the appeal of solo artists in the US.
 SVO-TEN (NCT) attracted over 20,000 fans across 10 cities during his first solo tour in the US.
 Báo Tiền Phong • 03/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 TEN kicked off his TEN US Showcase Tour in Seattle on October 17th (local time). This was his first tour as a solo artist since his debut. Traveling from Seattle to Chicago, TEN completed shows in 10 cities, with a total audience of over 20,000 people.
 On stage, TEN impresses with his precise dance moves and stable live vocals. He also connects with fans through his captivating stage presence and natural sense of humor, showcasing different facets of himself in each performance. 
 You may also like At the opening show in Seattle, TEN performed the songs S TUNNER, Nightwalker, Birthday, ON TEN , and Dangerous . He also presented new piano arrangements of New Heroes and Water , and for the first time introduced the previously unreleased song Can I Be Honest to fans there. TEN further showcased his vocal strengths with Lie With You and IRL , before closing the night with BAMBOLA and OUTWEST .
 Throughout the tour, TEN also revealed details about a new musical project, along with plans for another world tour, further increasing fans' anticipation for his upcoming activities.
 You may also like In September, TEN released the single OUTWEST , his first release since leaving SM Entertainment. The song quickly rose to the top of Spotify 's 'Daily Top Songs' chart in Thailand and held the number one spot for four consecutive days. Prior to the tour, on October 13th, he also attended the global premiere of the film Clayface at the Hollywood Legion Theater in Los Angeles.
 TEN debuted as a member of NCT U in April 2016 and was also a member of WayV. He will continue his tour in Atlanta, Baltimore, and Boston before concluding it in New York.
